This '''''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer''' was one of three that participated in the [[Battle of Death Star III]]. The ship caught a wayward [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] [[StarSpeeder 3000]] in its tractor beam during the battle, but [[Alliance of Free Planets]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] helped the spaceliner escape.<ref name="ST" />
